title: Meridian Credit Policy Section 6.1 - Credit Bureau Assessment
content:
## Section 6.1 - Credit Bureau Assessment
Credit bureau score bands drive routing and outcome constraints.

### Score bands
- 650 and above: standard credit pathway, subject to all other policy checks
- 580 to 649 inclusive: near-prime range, mandatory Credit Manager referral
- below 580: sub-prime hard decline

### Additional rules
- A score below 580 has no exception pathway under standard policy settings
- A near-prime score does not automatically mean decline, but the file must be reviewed under manager authority and still satisfy all other hard policy controls
- If another hard policy limit is breached, that hard limit determines the final outcome
